caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects, each with a similar design, placed on a plain beige or off-white background. Both objects are elongated and have a flat, rectangular base that extends into two narrow, parallel prongs. The wood is illustrated with visible grain lines and variations in brown tones, giving a natural, slightly weathered appearance. Each object shows slight differences in shading and shape, indicating individual carving marks and texture. The edges and tips of the prongs appear rounded and smooth. The objects are oriented at different angles, with one placed diagonally from the upper left to the lower right and the other angled from the lower left to the upper right. The drawing style is detailed and precise, with careful attention to the texture and natural color variations of the wood. There is a faint inscription at the bottom right that reads "Robert Gilron."
title: Clothes Pins
